# prism node Lookup --format text
# exit 0
// app/app.go — Lookup
func Lookup(s store.Store, key string) string {
	if v := s.Get(key); v != "" {
		return v
	}
	return config.Default
}

// neighbours:
//   calls in (2): All, TestLookup
//   calls out (4): Cache.Get, Cache.Get, Client.Get, Store.Get
//   uses-type out (1): Store
